reasons.A: Short, plain modern sentences and a matter-of-fact, slightly conversational stance lack the passage's long, cumulative periods and elevated earnest register.
reasons.B: Longest, most cumulative sentences with stacked appositives, semicolon joins and an earnest, lofty register closest to the passage's movement, though the lyrical closing image and rhetorical question lean slightly beyond it.
reasons.C: Right period diction, semicolons and polysyndetic lists, but sentences are somewhat shorter and more hedged ('I think', 'I am sure') than the passage's sweeping, assertive periods.
